local LP = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer

local OldNI = MT.__newindex

MT.__newindex = newcclosure(function(self, K, V)
    if not checkcaller() then
        if self:IsA("Humanoid") and K == "WalkSpeed" then return end
        if self:IsA("BasePart") and (K == "CFrame" or K == "Position") and self.Name == "HumanoidRootPart" then
            return
        end
    end
    return OldNI(self, K, V)
end)

MT.__index = newcclosure(function(self, K)
    if not checkcaller() and self:IsA("Humanoid") and K == "WalkSpeed" then
        return 16
    end
    return OldIdx(self, K)
end)

    local Method = getnamecallmethod()
    if Method == "Kick" or Method == "kick" then
        print(" the game try to kick you")
        return nil
    end
    return OldNC(self, unpack({...}))
end)

setreadonly(MT, true)

scripts.script:
local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")

local replacements = {
	["Respawn"] = "Reset Character",
	["Are you sure you want to respawn your character?"] =
		"Are you sure you want to reset your character?",
	["Are you sure you want to respawn?"] =
		"Are you sure you want to reset your character?",
	["Don't Respawn"] = "Don't Reset",
}

local patched = {}

local function updateText(object)
	local replacement = replacements[object.Text]

	if replacement then
		object.Text = replacement
	end
end

local function watch(object)
	if not object:IsA("TextLabel") and not object:IsA("TextButton") then
		return
	end

	updateText(object)

	if patched[object] then
		return
	end

	patched[object] = true

	object:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
		updateText(object)
	end)

	object.Destroying:Connect(function()
		patched[object] = nil
	end)
end

for _, object in CoreGui:GetDescendants() do
	watch(object)
end

CoreGui.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(object)
	task.defer(watch, object)
end)

scripts.features:
Aim

Aimbot — locks onto enemies, Standard / Legit modes
Body Rotation — rotates character toward target (Normal / Legit / HvH)
FOV Circle — draws a circle around the cursor showing aim radius
TriggerBot — auto-shoots when cursor is over a hitbox
TP Aura — teleports behind enemy and auto-attacks


 Visuals

ESP — boxes, names, distance, health bar, tracers, head dot, skeleton
Chams — highlights enemies through walls via Highlight instance
Crosshair — custom crosshair overlay (Cross / Dot / Circle / T-Shape)
Arrow Indicators — arrows on screen edge pointing to off-screen enemies


 Movement

Speed — walk speed multiplier (Hold / Toggle / Always)
Fly — free flight with WASD + Space / Shift
No Fall Damage — blocks fall damage state


 Misc

Anti-AFK — clicks every few seconds to prevent kick
Teleport to Cursor — teleports character to mouse hit position
Bring Unanchored — pulls nearby unanchored parts toward player
Hitbox Expander — scales each body part hitbox independently (R6 + R15)
Server Hop — joins a different server with open slots
Rejoin — rejoins the current place
Config Sharing — exports / imports full config via clipboard
War Tycoon TP — teleports to capture point, press again to return


 Settings

Watermark — FPS, ping, online counter overlay (Default / Minimal / Large)
Notifications — toggle sounds and style (Default / Minimal / Accent)
Theme — full theme control via LinoriaLib ThemeManager
Config Save — save and load named configs via SaveManager
UID — unique persistent user ID with clipboard copy
Online Counter — live session count via countapi.xyz
